notes.title: Patch Notes build 166
notes.notes:
Greetings, Wardens!

Thank you so much for your support and feedback over the last week. The launch of The Serpent Rogue is something we've been working towards for a long time, and we're so happy to see players enjoying their time with the game.

Your input has been invaluable, and has allowed us to quickly work on a patch that fixes several issues that have been raised, while also adding some quality of life changes to help improve your experience as Wardens!

Please keep your feedback coming! If you're enjoying the game, we'd highly recommend joining us over on Discord.

Patch Notes:

- New: effects on destroying stoned creatures

- New: ghouls can now be of different genders

- New: wood logs can now be found in some containers on the Wasteland as well

- Change: Weapons durability highly increased

- Change: Crafting can now have three slots for ingredients when brewing potions

- Change: description of some items in localization

- Change: the way Undertaker resurrects creatures (now the process is much faster)

- Change: adjusted Astroscopus attack distances

- Change: Snake attack range reduced

- Change: Removed icons from unusable icons on the map

- Change: Added one more moonstone on Swamp

- Change: Valravn can now sprint even on low Vitality

- Change: Worms in stump are now respawning on Pier location

- Change: Undertaker now can take damaged and brand new shovels as a payment

- Fix: infinite load issue

- Fix: crash when traveling between locations while riding on a Valravn

- Fix: not passable area after burning some objects

- Fix: Swamp softlock fix

- Fix: consuming food while being in the animal form changed players' race back to default

- Fix: Valravn maximum age could sometimes not trigger correctly

- Fix: changing weapons bug

- Fix: SFX of some attacks wasn’t stopping at some times

- Fix: fleeing Ghouls could behave in a wrong way in certain circumstances

- Fix: attacking while riding on Valravn

- Fix: gathering Reed and Poppy ingredient

- Fix: valravn special ability could sometimes throw the player behind the playable area

- Fix: popups could sometimes be opened in the wrong triggers

- Fix: age UI was not always updating correctly

- Fix: some achievements could be not activated properly

- Fix: interaction with Extractor was sometimes not responsive

notes.title: The Serpent Rogue – Release Date Reveal!
notes.notes:
Embark on a quest to save the world from a corruption known only as The Serpent Rogue. Coming to PC on April 26th. 

 
[previewyoutube=yS4DXKglLRA;full][/previewyoutube]



As The Warden, you must utilise each tool at your disposal to cleanse the realm and restore balance to Mount Morbus.  

 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40971068/2af43ee2c7e382d60e3165a57c1b9e2f733c1331.jpg

 
Alchemy is one of the key ingredients in The Serpent Rogue’s gameplay and mastering it will be pivotal to The Warden’s success; collect and research ingredients to unveil their uses, experiment with different mixtures to craft unique potions, and use those concoctions in a variety of ways to progress through the everchanging world. Each action The Warden makes has an effect on the wider world; for instance, if too many items are left littered around an area, rodents will arrive en masse to cause havoc; if bodies are left unburied, ghouls will be lured by their scent leaving death and destruction in their wake. 

 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40971068/1bdf61aa9c42bf445303bcfee4664852ea6e5fc9.jpg
 

The Serpent Rogue key features 

 

Sandbox roguelike: Explore the mysterious world of The Serpent Rogue; locations and items are randomised by storms that sweep the land 

Permutations aplenty: Utilise the magic and crafting of alchemy to create new tactics to overcome the many threats and situations created by the Corruption 

Cause and effect: The Warden’s actions have consequences that can be used to their advantage; but will they become the hero of the tale… or the villain? 


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40971068/010f8271eaf0db260bab474a4bd335a39f6a7889.jpg

 
Keen to know more? Keep checking back here for news and don’t forget to add The Serpent Rogue to your Steam Wishlist so you’ll get notified when the game launches! 


Stay in the know, follow the official social channels… 
 
The Serpent Rogue Twitter 
The Serpent Rogue Facebook 
Team17 Discord

notes.title: The Serpent Rogue Demo - Patch 01
notes.notes:
Hello Wardens,

We've made a few changes to our demo, including some issues reported by the community. Check out the full changelist below...

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40971068/3b57d119d6be2b4fb39691d720eb4d75ec848c5a.gif

Patch Notes:

 Fixed an issue that would cause a corrupt save file
 Fixed an item duplication issue
 Fixed a crash that could occur with using Warden Chests
 Fixed an issue that caused distorted terrain visuals
 Fixed an issue that caused smeltery recipes to be lost
 Fixed an animation issue for chickens
 Fixed an issue causing the Moonchest quest to not end
 Added a tip on how to lock on in combat
 Added ability to go back from character selection screen (this avoids having to see whole intro again)


We hope you are enjoying The Serpent Rogue demo. Don't forget to add the game to your Steam Wishlist:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1453790/The_Serpent_Rogue/


Want to leave feedback? Come chat with us in the Steam forums: https://steamcommunity.com/app/1453790/discussions/
